title: Evaluation Rubric
summary: Skill 出力の forward-test 採点基準。Rubric: Coverage model (20), Observation quality (15), Risk quality (15), Manual cases (20), Exploratory charters (10), Gate decision (15), Communication (5)。Pass Rule: 80点以上 pass, 70-79点 conditional pass。Automatic Fail Conditions: coverage model なし, P0/P1 case に oracle refs なし, gate が coverage 数値だけで Go, retired case が未実施扱いされる。
